AI / Probabilistic football analytics

Tabela

Fixtures, match analysis and forecasts you can compare with results.

A football analysis workspace bringing fixtures, match news, probabilistic score forecasts and prediction history together.

Web access available

The need

Reviewing pre-match information together and comparing predictions with actual results.

Approach

Poisson score probabilities with a Dixon-Coles correction, AI-assisted match analysis, a tactical pitch view and a forecast ledger for recording results.

Current scope and limits

The web interface is accessible. AI-assisted analysis requires an API key from a supported model provider. Data coverage and freshness depend on the sources. Predictions are experimental and probabilistic; no guaranteed result or betting return is promised.

Published information checked on 5 November 2026. An accessible interface is not evidence that every workflow has passed end-to-end testing.
